name: Kuroiwa Yuya
source: A participant in the Forum on the Case Against Uniform Abolition, even though he doesn’t feel too strongly about it. He’s just there because his friend, Akabane, leads it. A simple-minded person who speaks and takes action without thinking too deeply about it.
